name: labs/kletternaut__scopemcp
title: Owon/Abestop DS1102 oscilloscope (ds1102_mcp.ScopeController)
intro: Owon/Abestop DS1102 oscilloscope (ds1102_mcp.ScopeController), adapted from kletternaut/scopemcp. It reads `instrument_model`, `run_status`, `channel1_frequency_hz`, `channel1_offset_raw` and 4 more; sets `channel1_scale`, `channel1_coupling`, `channel1_offset_v`, `horizontal_scale` and 4 more; runs `autoset`, `run` and `stop_acquisition`. `autoset`: run the scope's automatic setup (:AUToset on). A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
